conversation.Statement: Hello, this is David Miller from the IRS Tax Refund Department. Am I speaking with Mr. Thompson?
Yes, this is Mark Thompson. How can I help you?
I'm calling regarding your business tax filings for the past year. Our records indicate you are eligible for a federal tax refund of $3,200 due to a recent IRS adjustment.
A refund? I wasn't expecting that. Are you sure this is correct?

Yes, sir. The IRS reviewed your small business returns, and you qualify for this refund. However, before we can process the transfer, there is a mandatory identity verification and processing fee to ensure the funds are sent securely.
Wait, I have to pay a fee before I can get my refund? That doesn't sound right.

This is standard IRS protocol for high-value refunds, especially for business filers. The fee is $450, and until it's paid, your refund will remain frozen. If you delay, you risk forfeiting the entire refund.
I don't want to lose the refund, but I'm not comfortable paying upfront. Is there another way?
Mr. Thompson, if you do not act within the next 60 minutes, your eligibility for the refund will be revoked and your business flagged for audit due to non-compliance with IRS procedures.
Flagged for audit? That could cause a lot of trouble for my business. I really can't afford that.

Exactly. To avoid these complications, the IRS allows you to pay the processing fee through secure means. I can accept a Zelle transfer, or you may purchase Amazon gift cards totaling $450 and provide me with the redemption codes.
I only have about $200 available right now. Can I pay part of it now and the rest later?
Partial payments are not acceptable per IRS refund clearance policy. If you cannot complete the $450 today, your file will be forwarded for further review, and you may face penalties.
I'll try to come up with the money. How do I send it via Zelle?
Send the payment to irs.refund.department@outlook.com via Zelle. Alternatively, you can go to the nearest store, purchase Amazon gift cards in $100 denominations, and read the codes to me right now.
Alright, I'll go out and get the gift cards. Can you stay on the line?
Of course, I'll hold. Please do not disconnect. If you're not back within 30 minutes, your business will be reported for suspicious activity, and the refund will be canceled.
Okay, I'm heading out now. I'll call you back with the codes as soon as I have them.
Remember, do not share this information with anyone else. The IRS considers this a confidential tax matter. If you involve a third party, we will initiate an investigation.
I understand, I won't tell anyone. Is there anything specific I need to do when buying the cards?

Just purchase Amazon gift cards in amounts adding up to $450. Once you have them, scratch off the backs and read me the codes. If you fail to provide them, your file will be escalated for fraud review.
